name: Kochou Yuukaku
source:
There is a fountain in the back of a dark forest ...
Black butterflies dance and invite me, and I walk as if fascinated.
There is a small pavilion there - the museum that no one knows about.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
